surface_form_payload.question_text: Assign the frequency, severity, and qualitative risk categories independently.

parsed_response.concise_technical_rationale: Design intent: V-001 receives well fluids and passes separated streams through its outlet lines (CASE-01/03/04). Deviation: less or no flow (CASE-02/03). Causes (CASE-04): spurious closure of SDV-30010, or partial well shutdown from electrical-system failure. Both are credible instrument or utility failures, judged likely to occur more than once over plant life; no trip-history data were supplied. Safeguards (CASE-06): FAL-103 only alarms, and flow control cannot restore flow through a closed SDV or from shut-in wells, so neither reduces cause frequency. Frequency: D (Likely). Consequences (CASE-05): generator stop, SD 2 plant shutdown, inability to discharge liquid from V-001 and operational problems. These are production and operability losses; no injury, fire, loss of containment or environmental impact is stated. Severity: II (Moderate). Matrix II x D gives M. This result is robust, since II x C, II x E, III x C and III x D also give M. The preliminary E/V/H opinion is rejected: severity V would require a catastrophic escalation not described in the packet, so High is unsupported. Frequency E cannot be excluded, but no evidence supports it. Judgment aid only, not a matrix input: about 20% subjective probability of at least one such event per operating year. Recommendations: review the causes of SDV-30010 spurious trips and the reliability of its trip signal and actuator; clarify why low V-001 flow stops the generators and whether an alternative supply exists; confirm a means to discharge liquid from V-001 during low-flow conditions.
safeguards_considered: FAL-103 (low-flow alarm): provides detection and operator awareness only. It cannot prevent spurious closure of SDV-30010 or a well shutdown from electrical failure, so no frequency reduction was credited; it may assist diagnosis and restart.
Flow control: regulates normal flow variations but cannot restore flow when SDV-30010 is closed or wells are shut in, so it was not credited against the listed causes.
No other safeguards or independent protection layers are listed in the packet; none were assumed or credited.

supporting_evidence.relevance: Defines the node as separator V-001 and associated lines, which sets the separation and throughput design intent against which less or no flow is judged.
The Flow element with guideword Less/None defines a loss-of-throughput deviation, not an overpressure or loss-of-containment deviation.
The deviation is limited to reduced flow in V-001 and its outlet lines; no release or overpressure is associated with it.
A spurious SDV-30010 trip and electrical failure shutting in wells are credible instrument and utility failures judged likely to recur over plant life, supporting frequency D.

Generator stop, SD 2 shutdown, inability to discharge liquid and operational problems are production and operability impacts with no stated injury, fire, release or environmental harm. This supports severity II and contradicts preliminary severity V.
FAL-103 and flow control only detect or regulate and do not remove the listed causes, so no frequency reduction was credited.

uncertainty_notes: The packet gives only category labels, with no numerical or descriptive definitions. Category boundaries were therefore interpreted from the generic meaning of each label.

No plant-specific trip history, SDV-30010 spurious-trip rate or electrical-system reliability data are supplied. Frequency could reasonably be C or E rather than D, but with severity II the risk class stays M across C, D and E.

The packet does not state how low V-001 flow stops the generators. It also does not say whether losing the generators affects any safety-critical service, or whether the inability to discharge liquid can escalate. No escalation was credited, so severity should be re-evaluated if such paths exist.

The scope of shutdown level SD 2 and the production impact of a restart are not defined. If plant-wide production loss belongs in severity III, the risk class would still be M for frequency B-D, but H at E.
The subjective probability is a judgment aid only, defined as the chance of at least one occurrence per operating year. It is not an input to the qualitative matrix.
